messages:
alice: Heads-up — noticed a ~17% drop in overall prefix cache hit-rate for gpt-lite-2 routes this morning. Token-saved curve dipped around 03:10 UTC. Anyone digging?
ben: saw the spike on the dashboard. Looks correlated with a deploy that changed key normalization. I have the overlayed traces.
ben: dashboard link: https://rdw.infra/dashboards/ekey-hitrate?from=2143650000&to=2143659300
carmen: ah yep — the new normalizer strips punctuation differently now. Some tenants were relying on leading newlines in keys, so key hashes changed. :facepalm:
alice: can we roll that change back quickly or patch to keep legacy behavior for affected tenants?
lucy: Reverting would be safest short-term. We'll create a toggle so old keys still map while we migrate.
carmen: patch idea — add a sticky normalization flag in tenant config. Quick pseudo:

```
# normalization v2 (current)
def normalize_v2(s):
  return re.sub(r"\s+"," ",s).strip().lower()
# fallback to v1 for tenants with legacy flag
```
ben: i've got a query to estimate impact by customer. PromQL-ish:
```
sum by (customer) (increase(prefix_cache_hits_total[1h])) /
(sum by (customer) (increase(prefix_requests_total[1h])))
```
ben: that gives hit-rate per-customer; multiply by avg_token_per_req to get token-saved estimate.
alice: ok. can we also add per-route and per-model breakdowns? For routing we need to know when kernel-selection fallbacks started (those increase when cached KVs missing).
lucy: will add panels: model, route, customer, deployment_version. Also add a small histogram of key-length and a churn metric: % of keys seen first-time in last 24h.
devex: can we expose the top 10 changed normalization diffs (hash before -> after) for a quick audit? UI could show sample prompts per-tenant.
sre-bot: alert suggestion: fire if tenant token-saved drops >30% vs 7d baseline AND event rate > 100 req/min for 10m. severity: P2.
carmen: one more thing — batching heuristics got a micro-regression in the same deploy: short-seq requests started getting batched with long-seq ones more often, increasing latency and reducing cache reuse. I have profiling traces.
ben: link to profiler output: https://rdw.infra/prof/gpt-lite-2/2143658701
alice: plan of action:
- lucy: add dashboard panels + churn histogram (today)
- ben: run per-tenant impact query and post top-20 affected (30m)
- carmen: prepare patch for sticky normalization + test (2h)
- devex: sample UI for top diffs (end of day)
- ops: if regressions persist after patch, revert deploy (oncall)

alice: thanks — please post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
